argv_binary_evidence.method: Static ARM9 disassembly of the supplied hash-pinned NDS core
argv_binary_evidence.finding: The startup forwards argc/argv through the VRAM entry. The runner saves them, selects argv[1] when argc > 1 and passes the selected path to its file-open routine. These are offsets in the ARM9 image, not relocated execution addresses.
